This codelist contains all CPRD codes (Read Code v2 / SNOMED concept codes) that indicate an active diagnosis of a **wrist fracture**. It includes fractures of the distal radius (e.g., Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi's fractures), distal ulna (e.g., ulnar styloid), carpal bones (scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, pisiform, trapezium, trapezoid, capitate, hamate), and fracture-dislocations/subluxations of the wrist, radiocarpal, or distal radioulnar joints.
